metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Iris Bookhold
records.biography_en: In The Other School Bells, Iris Bookhold takes the role of school librarian. “It was only due yesterday.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small stack of two books and a short bookmark with a tassel.

records.name: Wes Listenwell
records.biography_en: In The Other School Bells, Wes Listenwell takes the role of school social worker. “Tell it in your own order.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one smooth listening pebble and a tiny open notebook.

records.name: Pip Bandage
records.biography_en: In The Other School Bells, Pip Bandage takes the role of school first-aid helper. “Here. A small patch.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small plain first-aid pouch with a simple plus and one folded bandage.

records.name: Bram Cablefix
records.biography_en: In The Other School Bells, Bram Cablefix takes the role of school IT technician. “Try the end that fits.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one oversized detachable plug and little cable coil.

records.name: Jade Homeworkclub
records.biography_en: In The Other School Bells, Jade Homeworkclub takes the role of after-school supervisor. “You can finish it here.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small tray of colored puzzle pieces and one short pencil.

records.name: Gus Quietstep
records.biography_en: In The Other School Bells, Gus Quietstep takes the role of learning support assistant. “One step at a time.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: three rounded stair-shaped counting blocks.
